class Seg:
    __slots__ = ("eid", "v", "nxt")

    def __init__(self, eid, v):
        self.eid = eid
        self.v = v
        self.nxt = None


def comp_bfs(seed, adjl, nc):
    """seed: list of node indices at distance 0; adjl: adjacency of (eid, other).
    Returns (dist, parent_idx, parent_eid)."""
    dist = [-1] * nc
    pnode = [-1] * nc
    peid = [0] * nc
    q = []
    for s in seed:
        if dist[s] < 0:
            dist[s] = 0
            q.append(s)
    qi = 0
    while qi < len(q):
        u = q[qi]
        qi += 1
        d = dist[u] + 1
        for eid, t in adjl[u]:
            if dist[t] < 0:
                dist[t] = d
                pnode[t] = u
                peid[t] = eid
                q.append(t)
    return dist, pnode, peid


def build_fair_loop(cprot, edges, fair, enm_state, tgt, budget):
    """Closed walk of edge ids over cprot starting at tgt satisfying every
    declared fairness condition; returns None when that is impossible."""
    DECL = (1 << len(fair)) - 1
    lbl_bit = {}
    for i, (a, m) in enumerate(fair):
        lbl_bit[a] = 1 << i
    nc = len(cprot)
    idx = {}
    pos = 0
    for s in cprot:
        idx[s] = pos
        pos += 1
    emask = [0] * nc
    dmask = [0] * nc
    for i in range(nc):
        en = enm_state[0]  # placeholder, filled below
    i = 0
    for s in cprot:
        en = enm_state[s]
        emask[i] = en & DECL
        dmask[i] = (~en) & DECL
        i += 1
    fwd = [[] for _ in range(nc)]
    bwd = [[] for _ in range(nc)]
    ie = []
    for eid in range(len(edges)):
        s, lab, t = edges[eid]
        if s in cprot and t in cprot:
            u = idx[s]
            v = idx[t]
            fwd[u].append((eid, v))
            bwd[v].append((eid, u))
            ie.append((u, v, eid, lbl_bit.get(lab, 0)))
    tgti = idx[tgt]
    dist, pnode, peid = comp_bfs([tgti], fwd, nc)
    best = None
    for u, v, eid, ab in ie:
        if v == tgti and dist[u] >= 0 and (best is None or dist[u] < best[0]):
            best = (dist[u], u, eid)
    if best is None:
        return None
    _, srcu, backeid = best
    chain0 = []
    w = srcu
    while w != tgti:
        chain0.append((peid[w], w))
        w = pnode[w]
    chain0.reverse()
    chain0.append((backeid, tgti))
    covered = {tgti}
    covA = dmask[tgti]
    covEn = emask[tgti]
    walk_mask = 0
    at = {tgti: None}
    prev = None
    old = None
    for (e, t) in chain0:
        sg = Seg(e, t)
        if prev is None:
            first = sg
        else:
            prev.nxt = sg
        prev = sg
        covered.add(t)
        covA |= dmask[t]
        covEn |= emask[t]
        walk_mask |= lbl_bit.get(edges[e][1], 0)
        at[t] = sg
    prev.nxt = first
    del first  # keep name reserved
    # linked list root
    root = at[tgti]  # segment ending at tgti
    while True:
        viol = (covEn & ~walk_mask) | (DECL & ~covA & ~walk_mask)
        if viol == 0:
            break
        abit = viol & -viol
        covlist = list(covered)
        df, fp, fep = comp_bfs(covlist, fwd, nc)
        db, bp, bep = comp_bfs(covlist, bwd, nc)
        bestc = None
        for u, v, eid, ab in ie:
            if ab == abit and df[u] >= 0 and db[v] >= 0:
                cost = df[u] + 1 + db[v]
                if bestc is None or cost < bestc[0]:
                    bestc = (cost, u, v, eid)
        if bestc is None:
            return None
        _, u, v, eida = bestc
        x = u
        while df[x] > 0:
            x = fp[x]
        chainx = []
        w = u
        while w != x:
            chainx.append((fep[w], w))
            w = fp[w]
        chainx.reverse()
        chainx.append((eida, v))
        w = v
        while db[w] > 0:
            pw = bp[w]
            chainx.append((bep[w], pw))
            w = pw
        h = at[x]
        if h is None:
            return None
        oldnxt = h.nxt
        prev = h
        for (e, t) in chainx:
            sg = Seg(e, t)
            prev.nxt = sg
            prev = sg
            covered.add(t)
            covA |= dmask[t]
            covEn |= emask[t]
            walk_mask |= lbl_bit.get(edges[e][1], 0)
            at[t] = sg
        prev.nxt = oldnxt
    # output loop starting at tgti
    start = at[tgti].nxt
    out = []
    cur = start
    while True:
        out.append(cur.eid)
        cur = cur.nxt
        if cur is start:
            break
    if len(out) == 0:

    return out
